thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: HIGH - GPU autoscaler failing to provision in us-west-2, queue growth detected for model-serving clusters. Impact: elevated 429s and queuing >5m for some tenants. Root TS=2290012345
Samir (oncall-sre): I'm on it. grabbing logs and checking autoscaler state.
Samir (oncall-sre): ops-bot run /status autoscaler gpu-usw2
ops-bot: Running check...
ops-bot: autoscaler_status: ERROR, last_scale_attempt=2290012270, provider_response=QuotaExceeded, pending_requests=42, current_replicas=12, desired_replicas=20
Samir (oncall-sre): Provider returned QuotaExceeded. Looks like provider refused to allocate new instances. queue growth correlates with peak at 22:11 UTC.
Maria (eng-runtime): I'm seeing KV-cache hit rate normal. This is capacity only (not runtime error). Metrics: request latency increased as queue length > 1200 tokens waiting.
Alex (eng-platform): Any region failover policy triggered? Can we route to dedicated or quantized variants?
Samir (oncall-sre): Not yet. We have a fallback policy but it won't auto-run if provider returns 0 for scale. Need manual step.
Samir (oncall-sre): ops-bot run /list affected-tenants gpu-usw2 --min-queue 100
ops-bot: tenants: tenant-alpha (queue 430), tenant-gamma (queue 290), tenant-delta (queue 120), ephemeral-tests (queue 370)
Emily (customer-success): Heads up — tenant-alpha contacted support reporting higher error rates. They flagged production jobs timing out.
Jamie (product): Any way to temporarily throttle batch size or force use of seq_len cap to reduce token consumption?
Maria (eng-runtime): We can push a policy to reduce max_tokens_per_request for public route and drop priority for background workflows. That will lower GPU pressure but may increase user retries.
Samir (oncall-sre): First mitigations: 1) Engage emergency fallback routing to quantized model variant (lower GPU memory), 2) Shed ephemeral-tests and low-priority feature-flagged jobs, 3) Short-term rate-limits for heavy tenants. I'll run steps and report.
Samir (oncall-sre): ops-bot run /route fallback-enable --pool gpu-usw2 --variant quant-8bit
ops-bot: fallback routing to quant-8bit enabled for pool gpu-usw2. A/B weight: 30%
Samir (oncall-sre): ops-bot run /policy set-rate-limit tenant-alpha 0.5rps
ops-bot: rate-limit applied to tenant-alpha: 0.5rps (until 2290013200)
Alex (eng-platform): I'm flipping a CD to reduce batch size at edge for the public API in us-west-2. Patch: set BATCH_MAX=8 -> 4. Pushing now.
Alex (eng-platform): deploybot: staged config change pushed to routing edge.
ops-bot: Cloud provider report incoming...
cloud-ops-bot: Provider api: quotaRemaining=0 for instance-type g4dn.xlarge in us-west-2. Next quota window ETA: ~2h.
Samir (oncall-sre): Since provider quota is 0, additional provisioning won't help until cloud quota refreshed or we move region/instance-type. Options: request emergency quota increase (slow), failover to us-east or use smaller instance types, or continue software mitigations.
Maria (eng-runtime): I can allow more aggressive KV-cache reuse and bump per-request cache TTL to reduce recompute. Will apply to pool.
Samir (oncall-sre): Manual eviction for ephemeral-tests to free current GPU slots. ops-bot run /evict jobs --pool gpu-usw2 --tag ephemeral-tests --grace 30s
ops-bot: evicted 18 jobs, freeing ~3 GPUs.
Samir (oncall-sre): That freed a small amount, but queue still large. Enabling failover to us-east as temporary measure.
Samir (oncall-sre): ops-bot run /failover region --from us-west-2 --to us-east-1 --max-tenants 10 --exclude tenant-alpha
ops-bot: initiating migration of 9 non-critical tenants to us-east-1. Estimated warmup ~90s per lane.
Emily (customer-success): I'll notify tenant-alpha that we're applying rate limits and a fallback quantized model. Will include ETA and workaround recommendations.
Jamie (product): Please gather a short blurb we can send to affected customers summarizing root cause and mitigation.
Samir (oncall-sre): Quick log snippet from autoscaler controller: ```AllocRequest: desired=20, provider_granted=0, error=QuotaExceeded(provider=cloud-acme, code=429, message=\"quota exceeded for g4dn.xlarge\") Autoscaler: mark_failed_scale_attempt at 2290012270```
Maria (eng-runtime): Runtime logs show increased queue drain time: ```queue_length:420 -> 1200 over 10m; drain_rate dropped from 150 req/s to 45 req/s```
Alex (eng-platform): I filed an emergency quota request with provider support (ticket #CLOUD-98221). ETA unknown. Also started temporary provisioning in us-east-1 with smaller instance type c5g.large + quantized model container to approximate same throughput.
Samir (oncall-sre): Can you confirm that the quantized variant meets latency SLO?
Maria (eng-runtime): 8-bit quant variant latency is slightly higher per token but lower memory usage. For interactive workloads it's acceptable as an emergency fallback. I'll watch quality monitors.
ops-bot: failover complete for 9 tenants. Route updates propagated.
Samir (oncall-sre): Early signs good: overall 429s reduced by 40% for non-excluded tenants. But tenant-alpha still shows >200ms queue and some 429s due to strict rate limit we applied.
Emily (customer-success): Tenant-alpha acknowledged mitigation, asked for postmortem and ETA for full resolution.
Jamie (product): Noted. We'll need customer comms + action items.
Samir (oncall-sre): Temporary action summary: - enabled quantized fallback routing (30% then increased) - evicted ephemeral jobs - manually failed over non-critical tenants to us-east-1 - applied tenant-level rate-limits for highest consumers - filed cloud quota increase ticket
Samir (oncall-sre): Ops commands used: ```
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/api/v1/pools/gpu-usw2/route -d '{\"fallback\":\"quant-8bit\",\"weight\":30}' -H \"Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN\"
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/gpu-runtime --replicas=12
# eviction
opsctl evict --pool gpu-usw2 --tag ephemeral-tests --grace 30
```
Alex (eng-platform): I'll add automation to detect provider quota responses and auto-trigger region failover next week. Filing ticket infra-4687.
Maria (eng-runtime): Action item: create a prompt-level token-budget guard to reject extremely long-run requests during congestion. Filing runtime-3021.
Jamie (product): Action item: review fallback model quality metrics and formalize customer-facing fallback policy. product-2119.
Samir (oncall-sre): Incident classification: P2 (major customer impact to a subset of tenants, degraded for ~45m until mitigations). Start postmortem doc and capture timeline.
Emily (customer-success): I'll prepare customer comms for tenant-alpha and tenant-gamma. Requesting owners for follow-up: Samir (ops), Alex (platform), Maria (runtime), Emily (CS).
Samir (oncall-sre): Assigning owners: Samir -> immediate runbook improvements and playbook update; Alex -> regional failover automation; Maria -> runtime guards and fallback validation; Emily -> customer comms + postmortem review.
ops-bot: Note: autoscaler recorded 3 consecutive failed scale attempts -> elect leader backoff for 15m.
Samir (oncall-sre): Logging incident in tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2309 (I'll attach logs/screenshots).
Jamie (product): Thx team. Any lingering customer-facing risk?
Emily (customer-success): tenant-alpha still throttled but stable. I'll ping once they confirm back to normal.
Samir (oncall-sre): Closing live thread. We'll continue on postmortem doc. Please post any additional notes here before 2290013200. :white_check_mark:
